defects.summary: The 'refused' arm of S5.6.7 does not check that the row's coai-question-* scratch is gone, although the scenario's Then asks for it after every ending; deviation 56 records this gap honestly, but it stays open.
Deviation 60 says the status line 'stays "not yet reviewed by Opus"', but the edited status line does not contain those words, so the record contradicts itself.

S5.5.1 checks the scratch repository and canary only indirectly, through state 'answered' (the check's tree-changed rule), and checks only the grandparent of --home, not the <8 hex> shape of the coai-vh child.
The StandIn/Scopes helper is copied verbatim into both new test classes; this is now its third copy (AKimiConsultationScenarioTests already has one), when it could be shared.
KimiRow() repeats the KimiConsultant construction that Adapters() in the same class already holds, instead of reusing it.
A Kimi record was added to Records, but its doc comment still lists only the first five runtimes' run and the Vibe probe.

summary: The change delivers the E5.5 and E5.6 decisions exactly: the planner arm has no flags (Snapshot for disk, Scratch for none), the three Kimi rows cite the right cells with both file rows unconfined and web unmeasured, the vectors and generated table are updated, and any plan carrying a Leading, Flags or AddDirs fragment is refused naming the shim. All 12 scenarios are present and green, without sleeps or weakened pins. The findings are all minor: one gap in the refused arm (recorded), one self-contradiction in the plan's deviation record, and some duplicated test helpers.
